title: Eight liberators check links with molt_link_healthy, which passes a wrong target
objective: `alacritty` (its static form), `desktop`, `editors`, `iterm2`, `tmux`, `vscode`, `web` and `zsh` check their links with `molt_link_healthy`, which passes a link to the wrong file (eg `tmux.sh:15`, `zsh.sh:200`, `alacritty.sh:27`). Move each to `molt_report_link_faults`, as rule 5 of `docs/guides/writing-a-liberator.md` says, with a test for a link to the wrong file.
